data.change_summary: Refactored plant nutrient limitation from legacy total-mass parameters to explicit concentration-based semantics. Renamed three half-saturation fields in ProcessParams (plant_half_saturation_n_mg_total → plant_half_saturation_n_mg_n_per_l, etc.) with default values converted from mg-total to mg/L (e.g., 8.0 → 0.4). Added two new substrate-specific half-saturation parameters (plant_half_saturation_n_substrate_mg_n_per_m2 = 80.0, plant_half_saturation_p_substrate_mg_p_per_m2 = 12.0) that were previously derived at runtime by dividing the same total by the reference footprint. Removed legacy_total_param_to_mg_per_l/m2 calls from plant_growth.rs — parameters are now used directly. Added explicit doc comments documenting water-column vs substrate nutrient source assumptions and noting Phase 3 (E4) root-zone redox hooks. Updated presets.rs, default.toml, tank_scenarios/lib.rs, and docs/UNITS.md. Added 8 tests: 2 tank-size-independence tests (water-column and rooted plants) and 6 unit tests covering half-saturation, Gaussian response, weighted limitation, combined N, default Ks equivalence, and min-nutrient behavior.
outstanding_risks: Pre-existing compilation errors in 4 test files (plant_algae_integration, rooted_substrate_advantage, substrate_filter_integration, concentration_helpers) due to missing colonizable_area_factor field from a concurrent bead — not introduced by this change
Pre-existing habitat_registry test failure (substrate_deep_area_scales_with_depth_and_kind) unrelated to this change

Serialized save files that explicitly set the old plant_half_saturation_*_mg_total fields will silently receive new defaults instead of the old values — this is the intended behavior since the value semantics changed (total mg → mg/L)
The LegacyMgPerM2 provenance normalization variant is now unreachable but retained for the remaining nitrogen-cycle field renames (tanksim-6e5.2.3)

steps.description: Renamed plant_half_saturation_{n,p,c}_mg_total fields to concentration-based names (plant_half_saturation_{n,p,c}_mg_{n,p,c}_per_l) in ProcessParams struct with updated doc comments and default values (8.0→0.4, 1.2→0.06, 20.0→1.0)
Added plant_half_saturation_n_substrate_mg_n_per_m2 (80.0) and plant_half_saturation_p_substrate_mg_p_per_m2 (12.0) as separate substrate-specific half-saturation parameters in ProcessParams

Updated plant_growth.rs to use concentration params directly — removed legacy_total_param_to_mg_per_l/m2 imports and calls, added doc comments documenting water-column vs substrate nutrient source assumptions and Phase 3 hooks

Updated ProcessParamsPreset in presets.rs with renamed fields, new substrate fields, updated defaults (0.4/0.06/1.0/80.0/12.0), and fixed provenance normalization (plant fields now return ProvenanceNormalization::None)
Updated default.toml with new field names and concentration-based values, updated header comment to describe concentration semantics
Updated tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs field mappings for preset-to-ProcessParams conversion
Updated docs/UNITS.md to mark plant field renames as done (tanksim-6e5.2.4), added new substrate fields to the table

Added tank-size-independence tests: plant_limitation_is_tank_size_independent (10L vs 100L, water-column only) and rooted_plant_limitation_is_tank_size_independent (with substrate) — both verify identical biomass at same concentrations

Added 6 unit tests for refactored limitation terms: half_saturation_function_known_values, gaussian_temperature_response_known_values, weighted_limitation_factor_known_values, nitrogen_limitation_uses_combined_dissolved_n, default_ks_values_match_legacy_equivalents, nutrient_limitation_takes_minimum
Ran cargo clippy -- -D warnings (clean), cargo fmt (applied), cargo test (all 8 new tests pass, all existing compilable tests pass)

validation_evidence: cargo clippy -- -D warnings passes with zero warnings on changed crates

8/8 new tests pass in plant_nutrient_normalization.rs: plant_limitation_is_tank_size_independent, rooted_plant_limitation_is_tank_size_independent, half_saturation_function_known_values, gaussian_temperature_response_known_values, weighted_limitation_factor_known_values, nitrogen_limitation_uses_combined_dissolved_n, default_ks_values_match_legacy_equivalents, nutrient_limitation_takes_minimum

All existing compilable tests pass (save_load 27/27, determinism 24/24, budget_tracking 21/21, tank_size_thermal_response 3/3, cycling 14/14, end_to_end 17/17, events 5/5, chemistry 7/7, dissolved_oxygen 8/8, budget_helpers 1/1, water_change_mass_balance 10/10, tank_data 28/28)
Tank-size-independence test confirms 10L and 100L tanks with identical nutrient concentrations produce identical plant biomass within 1e-9 tolerance
Default Ks values verified: N=0.4 mg/L (was 8.0/20), P=0.06 mg/L (was 1.2/20), C=1.0 mg/L (was 20.0/20), substrate N=80.0 mg/m² (was 8.0/0.1), substrate P=12.0 mg/m² (was 1.2/0.1)
